name: ubiquiti-unifi-idsips-daemon
description: Parses UniFi gateway ubnt-idsips-daemon operational logs. Surfaces IPS enforcement failures ("ipset add failed") — cases where the IPS engine could NOT install a block — with the involved IPs, ports, and protocol. Signature alerts themselves arrive via CEF and are covered by ubiquiti-unifi-ids-ips.

test_samples.description: ipset add failure — IPS could not install a block
test_samples.input: 2026-06-30T17:58:08.671-0500    Warn: error handling event: ipset[ips] add failed ip1:5.61.209.92, port1:60869, ip2:192.168.1.194, port2:80, proto:tcp, err1:ipset v7.10: Element cannot be added to the set: it's already added

test_samples.description: ordinary daemon line without connection fields
tightness guard: Rust/Go 'LEVEL Target:' startup lines must NOT match (level has no colon)
